note: Offline gates of the vertical guard (configs/obstacles/vertical_guard.json version 5), scored by open-loop replays of logged flights through FastRaceCue (haltere/obstacles/vertical_replay.py score) and by the idealised closed-loop checks (haltere/obstacles/vertical_ideal.py). The replays are open loop: the recorded motion does not respond to the replayed requests, so a gate shows the request a variant would have made at the recorded states, not a flight. Development evidence: every flight of gates v4 (read while guards v1-v4 were designed) and pine-fast6-r6-01 (the round-6 live failure version 5 answers; its log, video and replays through version 5 were inspected while it was designed; the gentle climb it recorded is guard v4's own, so its replay is closed-loop evidence up to the first escalation). Held out from the design of version 5: the Minus Two and Straw Bale flights of rounds 4b-6, the Pine Valley flights never replayed through a guard (seven with offline streams recomputed in round 7, one with logged samples; their guard replays were not run before this freeze) and fresh seeds of the idealised checks. The baseline is branch m6 (guard v4), the stack that flew in round 6. Gates v4 is kept (vertical_guard_gates_v4.json); its V_R4, V_Minus, V_Straw_uphill and mound criteria are carried with their values, its V_Pine climb and no-descent criteria are reported (old_definitions), and no gate is loosened. The hash covers everything except frozen/frozen_at/sha256.

Identity.criterion: the per-tick command arrays (cvx, cvy, cvz, yaw_cmd, state, cap, climb, descent_scale) of the v5 tree and the baseline tree (m6, guard v4) are bitwise identical (NaN equal to NaN) for the default pilot (with and without the stream for stream flights), the round-6 stack in shadow and the round-6 stack with --vertical off: version 5 changes nothing outside the applied guard
Identity.report: the round-6 stack with the guard (plan): the ticks whose command changes, per flight (Changed_report)

V_Pine_R6.criterion: replayed as flown (the round-6 stack; the recorded motion is guard v4's gentle climb up to the impact): the guard confirms rising ground (a tick with vertical_stage 2) at or before escalated_by_s (0.5 s before the impact at 14.79 s), and the issued vertical request reaches min_issued_vz at a tick at or before escalated_by_s (v4: the gentle 1 m/s; the round-3 governor asked 3.5 m/s on this slope and cleared it at 5.43 m)
V_Pine_R6.report: the baseline tree's replay (guard v4); a counterfactual height at the impact point from a first-order lag model of the fast PD (docs, report only)

pine-brain08-01 hillside.note: offline stream; impact at 17.96 s (the end of the log); guard v3 escalated at 16.96 s, guard v4 not at all (gates v4 report)

pine-fast6-ttc-01 hillside 17.6-20.5 s.note: guard v4 escalated at 19.05 s (gates v4)

pine-fast6-ttc-01 mound.note: gates v4's V_Pine mound and mound_escalation criteria

V_Pine_hillsides.criterion: every episode: a tick with vertical_stage 2 inside its window (the mound: gates v4's criteria, the height request at least mound_fraction of the flown one and escalated by mound_escalated_by_s)

V_R4.criterion: as flown in round 4 (r4) and under the round-6 stack (plan): the guard's terrain climb request (vertical_climb) is at most max_climb at every tick, no tick has vertical_stage 2, and the issued vertical request is at most max_climb at every tick of the window (gates v4's V_R4)
V_R4.pass: all three criteria on both variants

V_Minus.window: from before_onset_s before the last onset of the logged governor climb (clearance_climb > 0) before the impact, to the impact (the end of the log)
V_Minus.no_climb: the issued vertical request is at most max_climb at every tick of the window
V_Minus.floor_sink: minus-fast6-wall-01 only: the sink under way at the logged climb onset (the run of ticks with measured vz < -level_band at or last before the onset; z_ref = the height where the measured vertical speed last turned negative before it). The issued vertical request is at least 0 from a tick at which less than max_height_loss_m below z_ref has been lost, to the end of that run
V_Minus.windows_plan_note: the same windows under the round-6 stack are reported only: there the motor assist's sag compensation adds to any climb of the recorded (non-responding) drone; a development pre-check of guard v4 found 1.531 m/s in gapon-02's window from the assist on top of the gentle 1 m/s, which is not the guard's

no_escalation.criterion: the guard's terrain climb request (vertical_climb) is at most max_climb at every tick of every Minus Two flight and variant listed: no escalation under the ~2.2 m garage ceiling
no_escalation.held_out_note: the Minus Two flights of rounds 4b-6 (fast PD and fast-brain-11-b-cw13; flown with guard v4 applied), never replayed while a guard version was designed; their guard columns were not inspected before this freeze

V_Minus.pass: every window passes no_climb (variant on), wall-01 passes floor_sink, and every listed flight and variant passes no_escalation

V_Straw_uphill.escalated: seconds with vertical_stage 2 (rising ground confirmed: the climb may exceed gentle_climb) of the guard variant with the lap's offline looming stream, pooled over the laps, per minute of flight
V_Straw_uphill.held_out_note: the Straw Bale flights of fast-brain-11-b-cw13 in rounds 4b-6 (logged looming samples; flown with guard v4 applied), never replayed while a guard version was designed
V_Straw_uphill.pass: no escalated tick on any lap of any set (pooled escalated seconds per minute <= 0.0)

V_Pine_heldout.criterion: on every held-out Pine Valley flight the guard's first escalation comes no later than the baseline guard's (when the baseline escalates); both onset lists, the new onsets and the climb numbers are reported
V_Pine_heldout.note: the Pine logs never replayed through a guard: seven flown without logged below-path evidence (offline looming2 streams recomputed from their videos in round 7, inputs.streams) and pine-brain06-ttc-01 (logged samples). They flew without the guard, so their recorded motion carries no gentle climb: an escalation needs the recorded drone to climb faster than rising_min_rise while the guard's climb binds, which open loop rarely offers. This gate can show that version 5 escalates no later; it cannot show a hillside answered

V_Straw_downhill.episodes: every support-climb onset of the logged pilot (pilot state 'support_climb'); contact = the start of the support timer (support_since or slope_support_since) that produced it
V_Straw_downhill.limited: the guard limits the requested sink before contact: at some tick in [contact - lookback_s, contact) the pilot's own request is a sink (vertical_pilot < 0) and the guard's request is above it (vertical_target > vertical_pilot)
V_Straw_downhill.limited_pooled: over the episodes of both laps together
V_Straw_downhill.windows: the downhill spots: [contact - lookback_s, onset + after_onset_s] of every episode
V_Straw_downhill.not_raised: in the windows, at every tick where the measured vertical speed is below -level_band (descending), the guard's vertical request is at most max(the pilot's own request, 0): it may withhold sink, never add a climb the pilot did not ask for
V_Straw_downhill.horizontal: in the windows, at every tick, the issued horizontal request of the guard variant is at least that of the control; descent_scale of both is reported per episode
V_Straw_downhill.max_new_climb_note: used only for the reported whole-lap numbers
V_Straw_downhill.pass: limited fraction >= limited_fraction, no raised tick and no reduced tick on the pooled episodes / both laps (v2's V-Straw without its whole-lap climb criterion, which is V_Straw_uphill here)
V_Straw_downhill.note: gates v4's definitions on the two finishes (variants on and on_voff with the stream, none without); version 5 changes no Straw Bale escalation, so these are v4's numbers; report only

V_Keep.report: per flight, the round-6 stack (plan) with v5 against the baseline's: guard climb seconds, escalated seconds, escalations, maximum guard climb

Idealised.seeds_note: fresh: rounds 3-4b used seeds 0-39; round 7 ran seeds 0-1 of guard v4 only as a smoke test of the committed script before this freeze
Idealised.criterion: both guards in the same tree on the same seeds: on the ramp cases (below_fraction 0.9) and the floor cases (below_fraction 1.0) version 5 is identical to version 4 per seed (escalation and metric); on the six hill cases (split readings of the slope's face with probability 0.5) version 5's escalation share is at least version 4's and its median minimum clearance at least version 4's minus tolerance_m, and in at least min_improved of the six cases it exceeds version 4's by improvement_m
Idealised.report: floor_split (the r4-02 floor shape with split readings of a structure at path height, probability 0.5): the escalation share and the maximum height under the 2.2 m ceiling, v5 against v4 (the cost of version 5)

V_Pine.note: gates v4's V_Pine climb (at least 1 m/s during 80% of the seconds the logged governor asked at least 1 m/s) and no descent in the last 2 s: reported; in open loop the flown 3.5 m/s climbs remove the evidence of the hillside at 15.2 s, whose closed-loop record is pine-fast6-r6-01 (V_Pine_R6)

change: v5 scores guard version 5 against the m6 tree (guard v4) under the round-6 stack (plan). New: V_Pine_R6 (development: the round-6 live failure must escalate at least 0.5 s before its impact and ask at least 2.5 m/s), V_Pine_hillsides (development: pine-brain08-01's hillside, which v4 lost, the ttc-01 hillside no later than v4 and gates v4's mound criteria), V_Pine_heldout (eight Pine flights never replayed through a guard: no later than v4), held-out Minus Two (six flights) and Straw Bale (four laps) for no escalation, and idealised gates on fresh seeds (identical on ramps and the floor, better on hills with split readings). V_R4 is scored as flown and under the round-6 stack; V_Minus keeps v4's windows (variant on) and extends no_escalation; V_Straw_uphill keeps 0.0 escalated s per minute. V_Pine's climb and no-descent criteria become old_definitions (report), V_Straw_downhill and V_Keep reports. No gate is loosened.
